name: @carbon/ts-plugin
description: TypeScript Language Service plugin that hides carbon-mini's custom syntax from the editor (so @CarbonApp on a function doesn't show as a parser error).
//dependencies: None. `@carbon/mini-solid` was declared here as `workspace:*`, but the plugin never imports it — it EMITS the string `import { mount } from "@carbon/mini-solid"` into the user's virtual file (src/index.js:37) so the TS server type-checks their code. A string in generated output is not a dependency of the generator, and V2 has no bun workspace to resolve the specifier against anyway.
